name: quiz-history-early-adventure
reviewNotes: All 176 original records reviewed as rendered ROM glyphs: 44 questions followed by three choices each. Preserve ordering, source line controls, numeric alternatives and dynamic hero references. No answer-key or scoring changes.

Famicom questions explicitly refer to the older game, not this SNES release. Preserve original historical claims and deliberately incorrect answer choices. Names from the older game's joke enemies are localized provisionally where no established project term is available.

Record 65 retains dictionary reference 02b9 (courage); the candidate must include the shared dictionary translation before native composition testing. Source review and compile checks do not establish natural quiz gameplay or answer-window fit.
